item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #SLPRSD
Issued at 02:00 PM 23 September 2026

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Sorsogon(Bulan, Irosin, Matnog), #NorthernSamar(SanIsidro, LasNavas, Catubig, SilvinoLobos, Mondragon, SanRoque, Pambujan), #CamarinesNorte(Mercedes, Basud, SanLorenzoRuiz, SanVicente, Labo, SantaElena), #Masbate(SanJacinto and SanFernando) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Masbate(Balud, Milagros, Cawayan, Placer, Mobo, SanPascual, Esperanza, PioV.Corpuz, Cataingan, Palanas, Dimasalang, Uson, Mandaon), #OrientalMindoro(Bulalacao, Mansalay, Roxas, Bongabong, Bansud), #CamarinesSur(DelGallego, Ragay, Pili, Ocampo, Tigaon, Goa, Tinambac, Lagonoy, Presentacion, NagaCity, Calabanga, Bombon, SanJose), #Catanduanes(Caramoran, SanAndres, Virac, SanMiguel, Pandan, Bato, Baras, Bagamanoc, Panganiban, Viga), #Albay(Jovellar), #Sorsogon(Donsol, Pilar), #Romblon(SanFernando, Cajidiocan, Magdiwang, SanJose, SantaFe, Looc, Alcantara), #Marinduque(Gasan, Buenavista and Boac) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

Keep monitoring for updates.
